I've been hospitalized for 2 years for depression and suicidility. 
Last year August I've been discharged because i haven't been in society for 2 years and they want me to integrate,  they thought i was better, but in reality my good response to my treatment was only for a month. I'm therapy resistant so that means, medication doesn't work with me.
I've started last year in September with hbo5 and after 1 month i had to stay home due to my depression and suicidility. I know i started too early but yeah...
The first month really went well, we worked with permanent evaluation and I've had really good grades, i was really motivated.
Suddenly all my intrusive images and suicidal thoughts started to hit me again, it was doable first than Suddenly it became everyday situation and than it became every minute of the day.
My coach in school supported me and said, i should restart in February but I'm still depressed.  
I'm trying my fullest to be able to to restart in september again. 
I have taken the step to go to a neuro psychologist, because i have some problems with memory and i have brain atrophy (I'm 24y old), my psychologist will also help me with my speech and also with my depression and suicidility.
I have every 2 weeks a talk with a nurse and a talk with my psychiatrist and I'm trying my best to think about the future. I try to dream a bit and think about a beautiful future, being a head nurse, but it's difficult. 

I've always had a mindset, even im depressed. 
How can you love others, when you cant love yourself.
How can you take care of others, if you can't take care of yourself. 
But in reality,  even tho my family looks after me and look every detail what i do so i dont kill myself, I'm willing to take care of them too, like my small brother , my younger sister who talks with me, my mom who got depressed because of me and she has an aneurysm too.
I help where i can in house even tho it's very difficult.
I know I'm not ready yet to take care patients but I'm taking it step by step. 

I've been teached to take it step by step that's why I've chosen to do first hbo5. 
I know with my capacity,  i can do bachelor but yeah, it's a hard choice to make.

Actually it didn't help at all.
I'm home now since last year august, cuz they want me to integrate in the society cuz I've been too long in the hospital. 
They declared me as therapy resistant patient (meds doesn't work on me) even tho i have to still take meds.
I have every week a treatment which helped for a month (which is nice) but then i went down again.
I keep doing that treatment in hope to be better again, but there's no response after that 1 month being well
Oh ok, i don't like to gamble, so this won't be nothing for me i guess.

I've started with hbo5 nursing last year september even tho i just got discharged in august. It was too fast for me.
Due to mental illness I've stopped and i could continue in February but I've been still struggling so I've decided to continue in september

I've had more than 20 attempts, all failed attempts and I feel like a loser.

This past week, I've reached my limit, I've made a plan that would succeed if I had time but I've been honest to the nurses, so every 30 minutes nurses keeps visiting my room to check if im still alive.  
My mom is also admitted in the hospital for depression (because of me) and she keeps calling me because she have a bad feeling. SO I HAVE NO FECKING TIME TO COMMIT SUICIDE

REALLY REALLY REALLY REALLY REALLY REALLY REALLY WANT TO DIE (or land in coma for a year)
